English: Sapling Stand
A humble, newly planted grove of saplings, tended by the clan as the seed of future tradition. Marks the beginning of a sacred gathering place.
Ancestor Marker
Simple carved wooden posts commemorating the tribes ancestors, fostering unity and respect for the past.
Prayer Tree
A venerable tree adorned with cloth strips and offerings, where the clan gathers to seek blessings and guidance from the spirits.
Spirit Shelter
A wooden shelter built to house sacred effigies and protect offerings to the spirits, forming the center of tribal ceremonies.
Idol Pavilion
A sturdier, decorated tent or wooden pavilion, housing clan idols and providing a site for formal religious rites and assemblies.
Holy Grove
A carefully preserved grove of ancient trees, ringed with ritual stones, attracting pilgrims and serving as a sacred heart of the clans faith.
Priests Hut
A well-built hut for the clans shaman or priest, who oversees rituals, offers counsel, and maintains the sacred grounds.
Diviners Hall
A large yurt or timber lodge for diviners and elders, a center for sacred knowledge and the interpretation of omens.
Sacred Canopy
A majestic, semi-permanent structure built of beams and draped felt, sheltering the sacred tree and all who gather beneath it for great clan festivals.
Altaic Tree Sanctuary
An awe-inspiring sanctuary of carved pillars and roofed walkways encircling the ancient sacred tree, famed among all the steppe peoples. The ultimate center of Altaic faith and unity.
